decisions.reason: The accepted pre-content setup covers the cover page, table of contents, and general layout; it does not change how photos will be selected or integrated.
Branding documents are an input to the accepted early layout setup, but the Agua Arc identity and applicable brand assets remain unchanged.
The accepted early setup does not change the requirement to integrate and format supplied tables in the final draft.
The same-message MODIFY already records the accepted first-draft and final-edit timing, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Early preparation of layout elements does not alter the required print-ready PDF delivery format.
The accepted layout preparation does not change Canva source access, ownership, editability, or asset policy.
Preparing layout elements before narrative content arrives does not change the requirement to package the eventual narrative content into the proposal.
The accepted setup concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and does not modify the TPEC proposal design requirement.
The accepted proposal discusses timing for final edits but does not change the established single revision round.
The pre-content layout setup does not alter the anticipated proposal page count.
